summary:
# ASTRA: Beyond the Frontier

**ASTRA** is a 3D science-fiction space exploration and survival game where players explore mysterious planets, collect resources, build bases, and survive in unfamiliar environments.

The game features several unique worlds, including Verdant, Mars, Europa, Titan, and Enceladus. Each planet offers different environments and exploration challenges.

Players must manage essential survival systems such as oxygen, health, water, food, and suit power. They can scan their surroundings, mine resources, craft equipment, research technologies, and construct their own outposts.

ASTRA also features spacecraft navigation, planetary exploration, a story campaign called **"The Last Hope"**, and a Free Play mode.

### Main Features
- 3D planetary exploration
- Survival and resource management
- Base building with six construction categories
- Crafting and technology research
- Spacecraft flight and interplanetary travel
- Story mode and Free Play
- Interactive HUD and ORBI assistant

### Project Goal

The goal of ASTRA is to create an immersive space survival experience that combines exploration, construction, science, and resource management.

**Explore. Build. Survive. Discover.**

ASTRA: Beyond the Frontier — Project Details

1. General Information

  • Project Name: ASTRA: Beyond the Frontier
  • Project Type: 3D Space Exploration and Survival Game
  • Genre: Science Fiction, Exploration, Survival, Sandbox
  • Platform: Desktop (Windows, macOS, Linux)
  • Perspective: First-person exploration
  • Primary Language: English (Russian language option also available)
  • Rendering Technology: WebGL 2
  • Core Technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Python, PyQt6, Qt WebEngine

2. Project Description

ASTRA is a 3D science-fiction game focused on planetary exploration, survival, resource management, base construction, and space travel.

Players take the role of an astronaut exploring unfamiliar worlds. They must collect resources, manage their life-support systems, construct habitats, develop technologies, and travel between planets.

The game combines fictional science-fiction elements with real physics concepts, allowing players to explore environments inspired by planetary science.

3. Main Game Features

Planetary Exploration

The game features five explorable planetary environments:

  • Verdant: A fictional jungle planet with luminous forests, crystal marshes, and underground caverns.
  • Mars: Rocky plains, basaltic dunes, impact craters, and lava tubes.
  • Europa: An icy moon with ice plains, ridges, and fractured terrain.
  • Titan: An environment featuring organic plains, hydrocarbon dunes, and methane lakes.
  • Enceladus: An icy moon with snow plains, tiger stripes, and ice fissures.

Survival System

Players must monitor:

  • Oxygen
  • Health
  • Suit power
  • Water
  • Food
  • Temperature
  • Radiation exposure

Resource Management

Players can scan their surroundings, mine resources, collect materials, and use them for crafting and construction.

Base Building

There are six construction categories:

  1. Habitation
  2. Energy
  3. Life Support
  4. Agriculture
  5. Science
  6. Vehicles

Players can construct habitats, energy systems, storage facilities, and other infrastructure.

Crafting and Research

The game includes a crafting system and technology progression. Players collect raw materials, create useful components, and unlock new technologies.

Space Exploration

Players can pilot a spacecraft, monitor fuel and ship life support, select destinations, navigate between worlds, and land on planets.

4. Game Modes

  • Story Mode — The Last Hope: A narrative campaign beginning with the discovery of a black hole moving towards the Solar System.
  • Free Play: An open-ended exploration and construction experience.
  • Multiplayer: A multiplayer option accessible through the main menu.

5. Missions and Progression

The game includes objectives such as:

  • First Contact — scan three objects.
  • Prospector — collect ten resources.
  • Find Water — locate an available water source.
  • First Habitat — construct a habitat dome.

Players receive research points for completing objectives and can progress through the game's technology systems.

6. User Interface

ASTRA includes:

  • Real-time survival HUD.
  • Planet and environmental information.
  • Mission tracking.
  • Resource and inventory management.
  • Interactive construction interface.
  • Planetary map and journal.
  • ORBI in-game assistant.
  • Spacecraft navigation interface.

7. Technical Implementation

The game is built using:

  • HTML5: Application structure.
  • CSS3: Interface design and visual styling.
  • JavaScript: Gameplay logic, world simulation, and interactions.
  • WebGL 2: Real-time 3D graphics rendering.
  • Python: Desktop launcher and local web server.
  • PyQt6 and Qt WebEngine: Desktop application dependencies.

The desktop launcher starts a local server and opens the game in a standalone Chromium-based window when a supported browser is available.

8. Project Objective

The primary objective of ASTRA is to create an immersive space exploration experience that combines entertainment with scientific curiosity.

The project introduces players to concepts related to planetary environments, gravity, radiation, energy, resource management, and space exploration.

9. Project Vision

ASTRA aims to create a universe where exploration, scientific discovery, survival, and creativity work together.

Explore. Build. Survive. Discover.
